I don’t have real‑time access to live exchange‑rate data, but as of the most recent publicly available rates (mid‑2024) the U.S. dollar is trading roughly at **1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP**. Using that figure:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \text{ GBP/USD} \approx £15.60
\]

So $20 would be about **£15.50–£16.00**, depending on the exact day and the bank or exchange service you use. Exchange rates fluctuate constantly, so it’s a good idea to check a reliable financial news source or your bank’s website for the most up‑to‑date rate before making a transaction.
